minutes.headline: Committee will stay dormant, not dissolve, until the planning board approves the master plan
minutes.summary: The Master Plan Steering Committee spent most of this short meeting approving backlogged minutes, including votes to accept several complete sets and two incomplete sets missing only adjournment information, while one meeting's minutes remain entirely unlocatable. The committee also discussed the master plan draft, now delayed for planning board review to March 16, and agreed to hold no further routine meetings but remain formally active in a dormant state until the plan is approved and the statement of work is fully satisfied.
